description: This test file for the voicewake configuration module contains test cases verifying default values, sanitization, persistence, and fallback behaviors of the voice wake configuration functions.

methods.name: loadVoiceWakeConfig
methods.description: Loads the voice wake configuration from the specified directory, applying defaults if missing or malformed.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sanitizes a list of trigger phrases, saves them to disk, and returns the saved configuration object.

methods.name: defaultVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Provides the default set of voice wake triggers.

ctags.name: saved
ctags.pattern: /^      const saved = await setVoiceWakeTriggers(["  hi  ", "", "  there "], baseDir);$/
